data.narrative:
Calogena is a Series A nuclear energy company founded by Julien Dereux that has raised €100M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a frontier-tech sector encompassing 3 public comparables (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private peers including Fuse Energy, Oklo, X-Energy, Nano Nuclear Energy, and General Matter.

The peer-median method proved inapplicable due to insufficient narrow-stage clustering. The nuclear energy peer set contains only 4 same-sector companies; filtering for matching stage, adjacent stage, and similar valuation tier yielded fewer than three datapoints in any single cell, falling below the three-company minimum threshold for reliable median estimation. An all-sector median would introduce material distortion given nuclear's distinct capital intensity, regulatory pathway, and technology risk profile relative to broader frontier tech.

Without a sufficiently dense comparable universe at the same stage and tier, traditional triangulation cannot be executed. A defensible valuation would require either: expansion of the analysis window to less-filtered nuclear peers (accepting broader heterogeneity), primary diligence on the target's unit economics and capital requirements, or scenario analysis anchored to disclosed financial metrics or milestone achievements. The €100M raised to date establishes a floor for investor committed capital but does not establish post-money valuation without additional disclosure.
